name: Heart Cap Mushrooms
description: Rare fungi Tarak needs for his alchemical work and as a peace offering to the myconids of Seagrow Caves.
properties: Found deeper in Seagrow Caves. Tarak's quest item. Presenting them (or mentioning Tarak) helps parley with myconids.
notes: Blocked by spore servant octopus at cave entrance (B1). Tarak points party to Seagrow Caves in Chapter 1.
